# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a construction blueprint/PDF takeoff platform.

Before substantial changes, follow:
- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/architecture/AGENT_ALIGNMENT.md`
- `docs/architecture/TAKEOFF_PLATFORM_REBUILD_BLUEPRINT.md`
- `docs/architecture/TOOL_QUALIFICATION_AUDIT.md`

Prefer extending `packages/takeoff-core` over adding new measurement math elsewhere.

AI-generated or heuristic results are proposals, not final quantities. Preserve units, stable sheet coordinates, provenance, and review status.
